text: dsh-xhs-note 是一个把小红书笔记整理成可复制文本的 DSH 工具。它通过 Cordis bundle 将插件接入工具面，并注册 format_xhs_note 工具。用户提供不超过 20 个 Unicode 码点的标题、正文和可选标签，工具会排出标题、段落、课程链接及带井号的标签。适合需要快速整理小红书文案的 DSH 用户；代码中没有配置密钥或账号要求。

dsh-xhs-note formats Xiaohongshu notes with the DSH format_xhs_note tool. Enter a title up to 20 Unicode code points, body text, and optional tags. It outputs formatted paragraphs, a course link, and hashtags. No API key or account is declared.
想把标题正文和标签快速排成小红书笔记。
帮我检查小红书标题是否超过二十个字并整理文案格式。
Format my note copy with a short title and hashtags.
dsh-xhs-note 的功能「小红书笔记排版」：调用 format_xhs_note，输入必填标题和正文以及可选的空格或逗号分隔标签；标题超过 20 个 Unicode 码点或正文为空会报错，成功时输出分段正文、课程链接和井号标签。

dsh-xhs-note README · dsh-xhs-note：Format a Xiaohongshu note (title max 20 Unicode code points) as a DeepSeek Harness tool. Do not pip the wrong dsh.

GitHub topic: dsh-plugin. Chinese: README.zh.md

dsh-xhs-note README · Try without dsh：node demo.mjs

Prints the sample title and the course URL.

dsh-xhs-note README · Install into a profile：This package is plain JavaScript. There is no prepare or build step, so a git install does not need allowBuilds.

dsh plugin --profile web add github:guobinmengxiang-rgb/dsh-xhs-note

Check the composed layer without booting:

dsh --profile web --dump-config

You should see a dsh-xhs-note layer. Then start the profile as usual.

Official CLI is @deepseek-ai/dsh (today 0.1.0-rc.6). The PyPI package deepseek-harness-cli is a different tool (dsh doctor / dsh chat).

dsh-xhs-note README · Honest limits：- npx may not load local overlays. The course overlay in dsh-getting-started still needs an absolute path to a TypeScript file.
- This bundle cordis.patch.yml uses the package name dsh-xhs-note, not a filesystem path.
- DeepSeek Harness is a developer preview: THERE WILL BE COMPATIBILITY-BREAKING CHANGES.
- The plugin runs on your machine.

dsh-xhs-note README · Tool：- Plugin export name: format-xhs-note
- Tool name: format_xhs_note
- Inject: tools
- Title rule: Unicode code points, max 20
- Default course link: https://github.com/guobinmengxiang-rgb/dsh-getting-started
